id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Single-host single-TPM peripheral bus. The TPM is a passive command-response slave attached either to a chipset legacy bus (LPC), a CPU-side serial bus (SPI), or a low-pin embedded bus (I2C). There is no multi-master / multi-TPM bus topology on the host side. The TPM presents a per-locality MMIO window (5 localities × 4 KB starting at 0xFED40000 on PC platforms).

supported_topologies.name: Discrete TPM on LPC
supported_topologies.description: Mainboard LPC bus; SERIRQ for interrupt; legacy PC platform.

supported_topologies.name: Discrete TPM on SPI
supported_topologies.description: CPU-side SPI bus; dedicated CS# and GPIO interrupt.

supported_topologies.name: Discrete TPM on I2C
supported_topologies.description: Embedded platforms (e.g. Raspberry Pi, automotive ECU).

supported_topologies.name: Integrated TPM (iTPM, e.g. PTT)
supported_topologies.description: TPM block inside the PCH / SoC; same MMIO API.

supported_topologies.name: Firmware TPM (fTPM)
supported_topologies.description: TPM service running in ARM TrustZone secure world or Intel SGX enclave.

supported_topologies.name: Virtual TPM (vTPM)
supported_topologies.description: Per-VM TPM provided by hypervisor (swtpm, Hyper-V vTPM).

master_slave_role_summary.description: Drives all bus cycles; writes commands, reads responses, polls TPM_STS.
Responds to MMIO reads/writes; never initiates a bus cycle; raises SERIRQ / GPIO only.

fields.interconnect_role: There is no protocol-layer interconnect: the TPM sits at a single fixed MMIO window per locality, addressed directly by the host. Localities partition concurrent access — locality 4 is reserved for the host CPU TEE (H-CRTM), localities 0..3 for ring-0..ring-3-class platform owners.

ordering_guarantees.command_atomicity: Each command executes atomically; partial command writes are aborted when TPM_STS.Expect transitions to 0 prematurely.
ordering_guarantees.pcr_extend_atomicity: Selected PCRs in selected banks are all updated or none; no observable intermediate state.
ordering_guarantees.nv_write_atomicity: TPM2_NV_Write commits before returning TPM_RC_SUCCESS — written value is durable across power loss.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: The TPM is a peripheral MMIO device — it does not own any region of the host's main memory. The TPM's internal NV is an opaque address space accessed only via TPM2_NV_* commands.
